newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Xiamen port to add 14 deepwater berths.
newsitem.headline: China's Xiamen port to add 14 deepwater berths.

text.p: The port of Xiamen in southeastern China's Fujian province will add 14 deepwater berths to help handle an expected increase in shipping over the next few years, the Xinhua news agency said on Friday.
The city would also build five mid-sized berths and three special-use wharves, Xinhua said.
The projects would cost some 4.6 billion yuan ($554 million) and would boost Xiamen's ship-handling capacity by 19 million tonnes, the agency said.
The special-use wharves included a 35,000-tonne power plant wharf, a 100,000-tonne oil and chemicals wharf and a 3,000-tonne oil and gas wharf, it said, without giving further details.
